notes.title: Update 6 - Performance
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32141578/f36f7c6cb8419e491528daf8c725b34dff818508.png[/img]

Our 6th update brings performance improvements for lower end PCs. Bodies are disappearing now after short delay for two of the lowest graphics quality settings levels.

Orb Gun is now nerfed with +40% (1s -> 1.4s) fire interval and +300% (1s -> 3s) reload time.

notes.title: EA Update 4: Early-Game Fun and Replayability.
notes.notes:
- Rewards from matches that can be spent for some extra cash to speed up the beginning of a match (More ways to spend the rewards soon).
- Pistol +33.3% fire rate, +12.5% DPS, to make it more enjoyable to begin the game.
- Rocket Launcher explosion range + 75%, post some screenshots of these explosions!
- Minigun +50% ammo, so you can comfortably spray without worrying.
- New loading screen design.
- Some boxes fixed on the map, that didn't block bullets and let you walk through them.

Enjoy ;)

notes.title: Update 3 Brings Nukes and Mushrooms
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32141578/50bc729e19e33004f001c304d5f110207c587286.jpg[/img]

Happy Exploring!

notes.title: Early Access Update 2 brings major balancing changes and much more!
notes.notes:
Waves 2 - 10 are now packed with more action. Map is more balanced to make finding a safe spot harder. Many bugs are fixed and conveniency features like radio-comms mute option added.

Have Fun,
Headshot Labs
